steps.eval: window.MTC.ready.then(() => { const h = document.getElementById('lamp-hint'); const r = h.getBoundingClientRect(); const d = document.getElementById('hero-desk').getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ hintVisible: !h.hidden, text: h.textContent, seen: sessionStorage.getItem('play.lamp.hint'), hint: [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.top), Math.round(r.width)], desk: [Math.round(d.left), Math.round(d.top), Math.round(d.width), Math.round(d.height)] }); })

(() => { const q = (s) => { const r = document.querySelector(s).getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height].map((v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10); }; const snap = () => ({ copy: q('.hero__copy'), disc: q('.hero__disc'), desk: q('.hero__desk') }); const eq = (a, b) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b); const early = Object.assign(snap(), { stamped: !!document.querySelector('#hero-desk svg') }); return window.MTC.ready.then(() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400))).then(() => { const after = snap(); const art = document.querySelector('.hero__desk-art'); const svg = art.querySelector('svg'); const btn = document.getElementById('lamp-pull'); svg.remove(); btn.hidden = true; const noArt = snap(); art.append(svg); btn.hidden = false; const hero = document.getElementById('inicio').getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({ early, after, noArt, sameEarlyAfter: eq(early.copy, after.copy) && eq(early.disc, after.disc), sameWithoutArt: eq(noArt, after), heroH: Math.round(hero.height), innerH: innerHeight, heroMinusViewport: Math.round(hero.height - (innerHeight - 48)) }); }); })()
